printf 'PID=%s\n' "$pid"
sudo -n awk '/^(Name|Uid|Gid|NoNewPrivs):/ {print}' "/proc/$pid/status"
printf 'PROCESS_ROOT='; sudo -n readlink "/proc/$pid/root"
printf 'PROCESS_CMD='; sudo -n tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline"; printf '\n'
printf 'ACCOUNT='; getent passwd appsvc
printf 'ACCOUNT_STATUS='; sudo -n passwd -S appsvc
printf 'LISTENER\n'; sudo -n netstat -lntp 2>/dev/null | grep ':8080 '
printf 'HTTP_ROOT\n'; curl --noproxy '*' --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 5 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/"
printf 'HTTP_HEALTH\n'; curl --noproxy '*' --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 5 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"
printf 'FIREWALL_RUNTIME='; sudo -n firewall-cmd --query-port=8080/tcp
printf 'FIREWALL_PERMANENT='; sudo -n firewall-cmd --permanent --query-port=8080/tcp
printf 'LOGIN_SESSIONS='; loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null | wc -l
